title: UK Visit Visa Help | Family & Business Visits | Manchester
description: UK visit visa help for family visits and business trips: sponsor letters, evidence and cover letters. IAA-regulated advisers in Manchester.
intro: The Standard Visitor visa covers tourism, visiting family and friends, and business trips such as meetings and conferences. If you are inviting someone to the UK, we help prepare both their application and your sponsor documents. We prepare your UK visit visa application, or the invitation for the family you’re inviting.
eligibility: The visitor intends to leave the UK at the end of the visit
They can support themselves, or be supported by their host, during the trip
The purpose of the visit is allowed under visitor rules

faqs.q: Do I need a visa or an ETA?
faqs.a: It depends on nationality. Many nationalities need a visa; others need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA). We check this first.

faqs.q: How long can a visitor stay in the UK?
faqs.a: Usually up to 6 months per visit. Long-term visit visas of 2, 5 or 10 years are available for frequent visitors, but each stay is still limited to 6 months.

faqs.q: How long does a UK visit visa take?
faqs.a: From outside the UK, most visit visa applications are decided within about 3 weeks. Priority services are available in many countries.

sections.heading: Do your visitors need a visa or an ETA?
sections.text: It depends on their nationality. Visitors from many countries, including India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria and Ghana, need a Standard Visitor visa before they travel. Visitors who don't need a visa, such as US, Canadian, Australian and EU citizens, must now have an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) before travelling to the UK.

sections.heading: What the Home Office looks for
sections.text:
Visitor visas are refused more often than people expect, usually because the evidence doesn't convince the officer the visit is genuine. The application should show:
- A clear reason for the visit and a realistic plan
- Enough money to pay for the trip, or a sponsor who can
- Strong reasons to return home, such as work, study, family or property
- A good travel and immigration history

A well-prepared invitation letter from the family member in the UK, with their own documents, makes a real difference.

sections.heading: Inviting family to the UK
sections.text: If you are inviting parents or relatives, we prepare a sponsor letter and help you gather supporting evidence, such as your immigration status, payslips, bank statements and proof of accommodation. We also prepare a clear cover letter explaining the visit.

sections.heading: Refused before?
sections.text: A previous refusal must be declared, and the new application should deal with the reasons for refusal directly. We review the refusal letter and help make a stronger application.

sections.heading: UK visit visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based at 61 Mosley Street in Manchester city centre and help clients across Greater Manchester, including Bury, Bolton, Oldham, Rochdale, Salford and Stockport. We also work with clients anywhere in the UK and overseas by phone, video call and email.
